name: Huevos Rancheros Bowl
summary: Fried eggs over saucy black beans and rice. A hot, savoury breakfast bowl.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 4 minutes, then add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and add the black beans. Simmer 8–10 minutes until thickened into a sauce. Season with salt and pepper.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining oil and fry the eggs to your liking.
Divide the rice among four bowls and spoon the bean sauce over top.
Slide a fried egg onto each bowl, scatter with green onions, and serve hot.

glutenFree.notes: Rice, beans, tomatoes, and eggs are all naturally gluten-free. Check any pre-mixed chili seasoning for wheat-based fillers if you use it.

budgetNotes: Serve over warm tortillas instead of rice if you have them — the classic version.
A spoon of salsa, hot sauce, or a squeeze of lime finishes it well.
The bean sauce keeps for days and reheats fast; cook eggs fresh each morning.
